title: Tech Note: Debugging XML with Export
author: David Adams
featured_technology: DOM XML commands (DOM Create XML Ref, DOM Create XML element, DOM SET XML ELEMENT VALUE)
DOM EXPORT TO VAR / DOM EXPORT TO FILE

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a debugging technique for 4D's internal DOM XML tree representation, which was invisible until serialized — a real pain point in mid-2000s 4D XML/SOAP development. The custom DOM_DumpTreeToClipboard utility and the underlying idea of serializing intermediate state for inspection remain conceptually sound debugging practice, but the specific DOM command set, the SOAP proxy code generated by the 4D Web Service Wizard, and the entire clipboard-based workflow are tied to a legacy 4D web services stack that has been superseded by REST/JSON-based integration approaches in modern 4D.
related_updates: 4D's SOAP-based Web Service Wizard tooling from this era has been superseded by REST-based web services and JSON handling in later 4D versions
The DOM XML command family still exists in current 4D but is used far less than JSON for typical data interchange today
